TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: transaction transaction to obtain a price rule by your id
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: execute() obtains pricingRuleId through getPricingruleid(), logs the requested identifier, and validates whether pricingRuleId is non-null and less than 0 before continuing. 2. Decisions and branches: if pricingRuleId is non-null and negative, execute() records warning advice ABKO00000050 and continues with the library call; after ABKOR000.executeGetPricingRuleById(pricingRuleId), if priceRule is null, execute() records warning advice ABKO00000040. 3. Invoked libraries and methods: execute() invokes ABKOR000.executeGetPricingRuleById(pricingRuleId); ABKOR000Impl.executeGetPricingRuleById delegates to callPricingRuleByIdDataBase, which adds pricingRuleId to the base query parameters, executes GET_PRICING_RULE_BY_ID_QUERY, returns null when the result list is empty, and otherwise maps the first row to PricingRuleGetDTO through mapToPricingRuleGetDTO, mapActivities, mapRelatedEntity, Utils.mapPaymentMethodsFromListAgg, and Utils.mapCustomAttributesFromListAgg. 4. Errors and subsequent actions: execute() emits ABKO00000050 with addAdvice(NEGATIVE_ID_CODE) and setSeverity(Severity.WARN) when pricingRuleId is non-null and negative; execute() emits ABKO00000040 with addAdvice(NO_DATA_FOUNDED) and setSeverity(Severity.WARN) when priceRule is null after the library call. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: execute() logs the returned priceRule and always calls setPricingrule(priceRule); setPricingrule adds the pricingRule output parameter even when the library returned null.

Accessed Libraries.Description: Retrieves the pricing rule identified by pricingRuleId by executing GET_PRICING_RULE_BY_ID_QUERY. When a row is found, it maps the first result to PricingRuleGetDTO with related entities, payment methods, and custom attributes.

Error Management.Description of the error situation: Invalid parameter: pricingRuleId must be non-negative.

Input Parameters.Description: Pricing rule identifier used to validate non-negative values and request ABKOR000.executeGetPricingRuleById.

Output Parameters.Description: Pricing rule returned by ABKOR000.executeGetPricingRuleById and assigned through setPricingrule, including null when no row is retrieved.
